references.text: Jesus warns the disciples not to let themselves be called "Rabbi" or "Teacher," and points out that they have only one Teacher, Christ, and that all are brothers, which reflects Jesus' own affirmation that he is the only true Teacher and Lord.
Paul emphasizes that there is one Lord, one faith, one baptism, and one God and Father of all, confirming the unique status Jesus holds as "Lord" and "Teacher" in relation to the disciples.
